{"language": "python", "code": "import re, os, json, subprocess
p='website_museum_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

# extract JS
m=re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>', s, re.S)
js=m.group(1) if m else ''
open('_extracted.js','w',encoding='utf-8').write(js)

# 1. count ARTISTS array entries
block=re.search(r'var ARTISTS\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\];', js, re.S)
names=re.findall(r'name:\s*"([^"]+)"', block.group(1)) if block else []
print("ARTISTS entries:", len(names), names)

# 2. ticket tiers
tb=re.search(r'var TIERS\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\n\s*\};', js, re.S)
tiers=re.findall(r'(\w+):\s*\{', tb.group(1)) if tb else []
print("TIERS keys:", tiers)
print("prices:", re.findall(r'price:\s*(\d+)', js))

# 3. FAQ items
print("faq questions:", len(re.findall(r'<summary', s)) or len(re.findall(r'class="faq-item"', s)))

# 4. ICS
print("ics date start:", '20261018T190000' in js)
print("ics date end:", '20261019T020000' in js)
print("ics filename:", 'artifact-museum-night.ics' in js)
print("blob:", 'Blob(' in js, "| download link:", 'download' in js)

# 5. newsletter + toast + validation
print("newsletter form:", 'newsletterForm' in js or 'newsletter' in s.lower())
print("toast fn:", 'showToast' in js or 'toast' in js.lower())
print("email regex:", bool(re.search(r'/\^\[.*?\]/', js)) or '@' in js)

# 6. modals
print("artist modal open/close:", 'openArtistModal' in js, 'closeArtistModal' in js)
print("ticket modal:", 'openTicketModal' in js or 'ticketModal' in js)
print("ESC handler:", 'Escape' in js)
print("backdrop click:", 'e.target === artistModal' in js)

# 7. nav active / smooth scroll
print("smooth scroll css:", 'scroll-behavior:smooth' in s.replace(' ',''))
print("active nav:", 'nav-active' in s or 'active' in js)
print("mobile menu:", 'menuToggle' in js or 'navToggle' in js or 'burger' in js.lower())

# 8. node syntax
r=subprocess.run(['node','--check','_extracted.js'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print("NODE --check rc:", r.returncode, r.stderr.strip()[:300])

# 9. required images
imgs=set(re.findall(r'https://source\.unsplash\.com/featured/[^"\')\s]+', s))
print("unsplash imgs:", len(imgs))
for i in sorted(imgs): print("  ",i)

# 10. svg map markers
print("svg map:", '<svg' in s and 'map' in s.lower())
print("gallery block/route:", 'route' in s.lower(), 'entrance' in s.lower(), 'metro' in s.lower())

os.remove('_extracted.js')
print("file size:", os.path.getsize(p))
"}
